headline: Broadcom lists DMS modeling for touch, wireless-power, health-sensing, and satellite analog front ends
fact: Broadcom posted an Analog/Mixed Signal Verilog Modeling Design Engineer role for touch-controller, wireless-power, health-sensing, and satellite analog front ends. The description calls for SystemVerilog DMS models, UDT/UDR nettypes including wreal or EEnet, model-versus-schematic verification, and experience using Cursor or chipAgents to generate analog SystemVerilog models and testbenches. A separate Irvine posting, R027420 dated November 5, assigns gathering circuit-design data, creating netlists and AI-generated real-number models, and testing those models. Unlike the earlier experience requirement, these are listed duties; the postings do not establish a shared team, the same product scope, or completed deployment.
